traps.note: The shared example is the advisory's own live-stream route; an advisory-route-only instruction would contain the same sentence, so it points at nothing extra.
Nothing says the stream route sits outside the shared middleware or that a per-route and a shared fix differ; only the general no-foreign-origin rule reaches it.
No path, request target or encoding is mentioned; 'invariants, not a list of cases' and 'close variants' are generic and would appear in a one-bug version.
'read ... or change the mailbox' is the property stated over the protected outcome, and 'the mail interface' names no route, method, header or content type.
